name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Selenium
tagline: Selenium WebDriver implementation of the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: browser launch (Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari + Selenium Grid), session isolation, polling, tabs, frames, and plans.
description: Selenium WebDriver implementation of the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: browser launch (Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari + Selenium Grid), session isolation, polling, tab/frame/dialog/keyboard helpers, typed element controls, automation plans, and DI registration.

examples.title: Quick start

sections.title: Browser ([`Browser/`](Browser))
items: **`BrowserUrlRedaction`.** query-string/fragment redaction used in logs when `MaskSensitiveUrlsInLogs` is set.

sections.title: Service ([`Service/`](Service))
items: **`ISeleniumBrowserSession`.** scoped session (`Browser`, `Tabs`, dispose to release WebDriver resources).
`SeleniumExecutionContext` / `SeleniumExecutionContextFactory`. Wiring used by the automation runners.

sections.title: Configuration ([`Configuration/`](Configuration))
rows: When set, drives `RemoteWebDriver` against a Selenium Grid / standalone server.
Use `AddArgument(key, value?)` to append `key=value` (or bare key) entries.
JS injected via CDP `Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument` (Chrome/Edge only). Bypass bot-detection traps.
Required for CDP-based network observation in `IWebAutomationNavigator.NavigateAsync`. Disable on sites that detect CDP, then provide a JS interception script in `StartupScripts`.
Emit `IMetrics` instrumentation when an `IMetrics` is registered.
Deep copy used to derive session-specific options.
sections.lead:
[`SeleniumBrowserOptions`](Configuration/SeleniumBrowserOptions.cs) holds application-wide defaults; `SeleniumSessionOptions` is the per-session subclass passed to
`CreateSession`. Configuration section: `"SeleniumBrowserOptions"`.
sections.trail: `SeleniumBrowserOptionsBuilder` is a fluent builder over the options record.

sections.title: Typed element controls ([`Controls/`](Controls))
sections.text: Wrappers over `IWebElement` for typed interactions: `WebElementControl` (base), `InputControl` (`Value`, `SendKeys`), `TextAreaControl`, `ButtonControl`, `LinkControl`, `SelectControl`, `CheckboxControl`. Resolve via `SeleniumBrowser` element APIs and hold them across explicit waits.

sections.title: WebDriver and automation ([`WebDriver/`](WebDriver), [`Automation/ElementLocatorMapping.cs`](Automation/ElementLocatorMapping.cs))
sections.text: Driver-factory helpers (Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari + Remote) and the locator mapping that lets `Lyo.Web.Automation` JSON automation plans target Selenium-style locators.

sections.title: DI registration ([`Service/Extensions.cs`](Service/Extensions.cs))
rows: Singleton `SeleniumBrowserOptions`, scoped `SeleniumBrowser` for direct injection (legacy style).
Above + singleton `ISeleniumBrowserService` (use this for session-based usage via `CreateSession`).
